title: H-SHAP reproducibility package: hierarchical Owen value for auditing gradient-boosted insurance pricing models
description: Code, locked pre-registration, reference results, encodings and LightGBM models used by the H-SHAP paper (hierarchical Owen value as an explanation-auditing mechanism for gradient-boosted models on hierarchical categorical representations in property insurance ratemaking), using public NFIP flood-insurance data. Raw OpenFEMA data are not included; see README.md for the replay procedure.
